en.title: Word Counter: count words, characters and reading time
en.description: Paste your text to count words, characters and reading time instantly. Runs in your browser, so nothing you type is uploaded or stored.
en.lede: Paste or type your text to see the word count, character count and estimated reading time. It updates as you type and never leaves your browser.

steps.title: Paste or type your text
steps.body: Click the box and paste from any document, email or web page, or start typing. The counts update on every keystroke.

steps.title: Read the numbers
steps.body: Words, characters with and without spaces, and reading time appear below the box. Chinese and Japanese text is counted per word segment, not per space.

steps.title: Edit until you hit your limit
steps.body: Trim or extend the text and watch the numbers change. Use the character counts for limits such as meta descriptions, posts and form fields.

faq: How does the word counter decide what a word is?

It uses the browser's built-in word segmentation for your language. In English that means runs of letters and numbers separated by spaces or punctuation, so a hyphenated term like well-known counts as two words.

Alphabetic text is timed at 238 words per minute, the average silent reading speed for adults. Chinese text is timed at 400 characters per minute. Treat the result as an estimate, since technical or dense writing reads slower.
Is my text uploaded or saved anywhere?
No. The counting happens in your browser tab. Nothing you type is sent to a server, and clearing the box or closing the tab removes it.

zh.title: 字数统计：统计字数、字符数和阅读时间
zh.description: 粘贴文本即可即时统计字数、字符数和预计阅读时间。全部在浏览器里完成，你输入的内容不会上传，也不会保存。
zh.lede: 粘贴或输入文本，立即看到字数、字符数和预计阅读时间。统计在输入时实时更新，内容不会离开你的浏览器。

steps.title: 粘贴或输入文本
steps.body: 点击文本框，从文档、邮件或网页粘贴内容，或者直接输入。每次按键后数字都会更新。

steps.title: 查看统计结果
steps.body: 文本框下方显示词数、含空格和不含空格的字符数，以及阅读时间。中日文按词语切分计数，不依赖空格。

steps.title: 改到符合要求为止
steps.body: 删减或补充文本，数字随之变化。可以用字符数核对摘要、帖子和表单字段的长度限制。

faq: 字数统计怎么判断一个词？
使用浏览器内置的分词功能，按你当前的语言处理。英文按空格和标点分隔的字母数字串计数，所以 well-known 这类连字符词算两个词。
字母文字按每分钟 238 个词计算，这是成年人默读的平均速度；中文按每分钟 400 个字计算。结果只是估计，技术类或信息密集的文章读起来会更慢。
我输入的文本会被上传或保存吗？
不会。统计在你的浏览器标签页里完成，输入的内容不会发送到服务器。清空文本框或关闭标签页后内容即消失。
